IRON YARD — owner-authorized one-shot PUBLIC Roblox update, 12 November 2026.

The user requested continued improvement and publication on the EXISTING
PUBLIC IRON YARD Roblox experience, never a duplicate/private alpha.
This single release covers merged PR #40, source commit
4b85d277a6986896cb6d541ef2f80d7afc8370fe.

The owner/Studio-only PERF panel now displays first-person viewmodel CPU
callback mean/peak, active transient effect count and its adaptive budget,
current weapon type, PBR/procedural source and model part count, alongside
the existing local FPS P95/P99 and server bot timing metrics.

Profiling uses an opt-in local-only attribute, measures only when owner
opens PERF, and publishes one lightweight snapshot per second. A pure
fixed-memory diagnostics policy rejects invalid samples/Android suspension
gaps. All ordinary public players keep profiling disabled and have no
extra gameplay telemetry. No server/combat/aim/ammo/hitbox or PBR visuals
were modified. CPU callback time must not be claimed as GPU rendering time.

Full Luau compile, executable regression and Python integration contracts,
plus Rojo build are GREEN on PR and on merged main. Require a NEW full
green CI for this exact release authorization commit, then independently
verify the original Roblox owner, PUBLIC universe and original root place.
Publish only the existing public game with no additional universe/place.
No personal IDs or secrets are stored in this file. Device FPS still
requires an actual Android playtest; do not assert measured gains.
